definition.text: House of wastes, or deserts, a town near Abel-shittim, east of Jordan, in the desert of Moab, where the Israelites encamped not long before crossing the Jordan (Num. 33:49; A.V., “Bethjesimoth”). It was within the territory of Sihon, king of the Amorites (Josh. 12:3).

lemmas.gloss: Beth-ha-Jeshimoth, a town East of the Jordan
Ashdoth-Pisgah, a place east of the Jordan
Moab, an incestuous son of Lot
